mostWorthwhile.text: Building the capillary bed was most worthwhile: it showed oxygen and nutrients moving toward cells, carbon dioxide moving back, and blood cells staying inside vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Lining the veins felt less interesting because it repeated the earlier artery-lining step, although the arrows clarified the different directions.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the picture of a contracting muscle squeezing a vein and helping move blood through its valves.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained the pairings, though the final connections were the only offered actions.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the exchange and valve pictures made the vessel route understandable, and I'd be curious to see how it connects to another body system.
